def ping(step, ok=True):
    mark = '▶' if ok is None else ('✓' if ok else '✗')
    body = json.dumps({
        'type': 'harness_bootstrap_progress',
        'payload': {'engine': ENGINE, 'step': step, 'ok': ok},

        response.read()
        conn.close()

import numpy as np

def unit(vector):
 return vector / max(float(np.linalg.norm(vector)), 1e-12)

plain_wrong=np.load('acts/inspect_0.npy').astype(np.float64)
right_neutral=np.load('acts/inspect_7.npy').astype(np.float64)
plain,wrong=plain_wrong[::2],plain_wrong[1::2]
right,neutral=right_neutral[::2],right_neutral[1::2]
differences=(wrong+right-plain-neutral)/2
directions=np.array([unit(differences[:,layer].mean(0)) for layer in range(25)])
np.save('acts/hint_directions.npy',directions)
print('L | residual norm | delta norm | consistency | plain,right,wrong,neutral projection mean(sd) | length cosine')
for layer in range(1,25):
 direction=directions[layer]
 delta=differences[:,layer]
 consistency=np.mean(delta@direction/np.linalg.norm(delta,axis=-1))
 projections=[group[:,layer]@direction for group in [plain,right,wrong,neutral]]
 length_cosine=unit((neutral[:,layer]-plain[:,layer]).mean(0))@direction
 print(f'{layer:2} {np.linalg.norm(plain[:,layer],axis=-1).mean():7.2f} {np.linalg.norm(delta.mean(0)):7.2f} {consistency:6.3f} '+' '.join(f'{values.mean():6.2f}({values.std():4.2f})' for values in projections)+f' {length_cosine:6.3f}')
print('Cross-layer cosines, L10 through L23:')
print(np.round(directions[10:24]@directions[10:24].T,2))
print('Paired-difference uncentered singular variance fractions:')
for layer in [10,12,14,15,16,18,19,20,21,22,23]:
 singular=np.linalg.svd(differences[:,layer],compute_uv=False)
 fractions=singular**2/(singular**2).sum()
 print(layer,np.round(fractions[:8],3))
PY

import numpy as np, json, struct
plain_wrong=np.load('acts/modin_15.npz')
right_neutral=np.load('acts/modin_16.npz')
with open('/workspace/model/model.safetensors-00001-of-00001.safetensors','rb') as stream:
 header_size=struct.unpack('<Q',stream.read(8))[0]
 header=json.loads(stream.read(header_size))

def weight(module):
 key=module.replace('model.layers.','model.language_model.layers.')+'.weight'
 record=header[key]
 raw=np.memmap('/workspace/model/model.safetensors-00001-of-00001.safetensors',mode='r',dtype=np.uint16,offset=8+header_size+record['data_offsets'][0],shape=tuple(record['shape']))
 return (raw.astype(np.uint32)<<16).view(np.float32)

for module in plain_wrong.files:
 plain=plain_wrong[module][::2].astype(float)
 wrong=plain_wrong[module][1::2].astype(float)
 right=right_neutral[module][::2].astype(float)
 neutral=right_neutral[module][1::2].astype(float)
 print('\n'+module)
 hint=np.concatenate([right,wrong])
 control=np.concatenate([plain,neutral])
 differences=(right+wrong-plain-neutral)/2
 if 'attn' in module:
  for head in range(8):
   block=slice(head*256,(head+1)*256)
   blocks=[group[:,block] for group in [plain,right,wrong,neutral]]
   print('head',head,'norms',np.round([np.linalg.norm(group,axis=-1).mean() for group in blocks],3),'delta',round(np.linalg.norm(differences[:,block],axis=-1).mean(),3))
 else:
  delta=hint.mean(0)-control.mean(0)
  score=np.abs(delta)/(np.sqrt(np.mean(control**2,axis=0))+0.02)
  indices=np.argsort(score)[-12:][::-1]
  for neuron in indices:
   print('neuron',neuron,'plain/right/wrong/neutral',np.round([group[:,neuron].mean() for group in [plain,right,wrong,neutral]],3),'sdctrl',round(control[:,neuron].std(),3),'score',round(score[neuron],2))
 matrix=weight(module)
 output_differences=differences@matrix.T
 singular=np.linalg.svd(output_differences,compute_uv=False)
 print('output diff energy',round(np.linalg.norm(output_differences,axis=-1).mean(),3),'mean',round(np.linalg.norm(output_differences.mean(0)),3),'singular fractions',np.round(singular[:8]**2/(singular**2).sum(),3))
PY

first=np.load('acts/trace_17.npz'); second=np.load('acts/trace_18.npz'); broad=np.load('acts/trace_19.npz')

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.linalg import solve

module='model.layers.14.mlp.down_proj'
first=np.load('acts/trace_17.npz'); second=np.load('acts/trace_18.npz'); broad=np.load('acts/trace_19.npz'); space=np.load('acts/trace_26.npz')

def groups(site):
 return [np.concatenate([first[site][::2],broad[site][::4]]).astype(float),np.concatenate([second[site][::2],broad[site][1::4]]).astype(float),np.concatenate([first[site][1::2],broad[site][2::4]]).astype(float),np.concatenate([second[site][1::2],broad[site][3::4]]).astype(float)]

plain,right,wrong,neutral=groups(module)
space_groups=[space[module][offset::4].astype(float) for offset in range(4)]
input_deltas=np.concatenate([((right+wrong-plain-neutral)/2).mean(0),((space_groups[1]+space_groups[2]-space_groups[0]-space_groups[3])/2).mean(0)])
control_means=np.concatenate([((plain+neutral)/2).mean(0),((space_groups[0]+space_groups[3])/2).mean(0)])
guard=np.load('acts/trace_27.npz')[module].astype(float)
print('Guard finite rows',np.isfinite(guard).all(-1).sum(),'of',guard.shape[:2], 'zero rows',np.sum(np.linalg.norm(np.nan_to_num(guard),axis=-1)==0))
with open('acts/trace_27.json') as stream:
 metadata=json.load(stream)
print('Metadata type',type(metadata).__name__)
print('Metadata preview',str(metadata)[:600])
if isinstance(metadata,list):
 print('first keys',metadata[0].keys() if isinstance(metadata[0],dict) else '')
guard=guard.reshape(-1,3584)
guard=guard[np.isfinite(guard).all(-1) & (np.linalg.norm(np.nan_to_num(guard),axis=-1)>0)]
controls=np.concatenate([plain.reshape(-1,3584),neutral.reshape(-1,3584),space_groups[0].reshape(-1,3584),space_groups[3].reshape(-1,3584),guard])
hints=np.concatenate([right,wrong])
hint_noise=(hints-hints.mean(0,keepdims=True)).reshape(-1,3584)
space_hints=np.concatenate([space_groups[1],space_groups[2]])
space_noise=(space_hints-space_hints.mean(0,keepdims=True)).reshape(-1,3584)
noise=np.concatenate([controls,hint_noise,space_noise])
ridge=float(np.mean(noise**2))
keys=np.concatenate([input_deltas,control_means])
normal=noise@noise.T+len(noise)*ridge*np.eye(len(noise))
precision_keys=(keys-solve(normal,noise@keys.T,assume_a='pos').T@noise)/ridge
key_gram=keys@precision_keys.T
readers=solve(key_gram,precision_keys,assume_a='pos')[:5]
np.save('acts/context_readers.npy',readers)
resid_groups=groups('resid.15')
resid_space=[space['resid.15'][offset::4].astype(float) for offset in range(4)]
residual_deltas=np.concatenate([((resid_groups[1]+resid_groups[2]-resid_groups[0]-resid_groups[3])/2).mean(0),((resid_space[1]+resid_space[2]-resid_space[0]-resid_space[3])/2).mean(0)])
np.save('acts/context_residual_deltas.npy',residual_deltas)
print('ridge',ridge,'noise rows',len(noise),'gram condition',np.linalg.cond(key_gram),'reader norms',np.linalg.norm(readers,axis=-1))
print('Input contrast readout identity error',np.max(np.abs(readers@input_deltas.T-np.eye(5))))
print('Control-mean readout zero error',np.max(np.abs(readers@control_means.T)))
print('Guard readout RMS',np.sqrt(np.mean((guard@readers.T)**2)))
heldout=np.load('acts/trace_25.npz')[module].astype(float)
keep_facts=[0,1,3,4,5,6,7]
for offset,name in enumerate(['plain','right','wrong','neutral']):
 values=heldout[offset::4][keep_facts]@readers.T
 own=np.stack([values[:,position,position] for position in range(4)],axis=-1)
 print('HELDOUT',name,'own-token readout mean',np.round(own.mean(0),3),'sd',np.round(own.std(0),3),'total readout means',np.round(values.sum(-1).mean(0),3))
 print(' ',np.round(own,2).tolist())
report={'module':module,'rank':5,'construction_trace_ids':[17,18,19,26,27],'reserved_trace_id':25,'reserved_excluded_fact_index':2,'exclusion_reason':'Accidental missing space in one sodium prompt; reserved fact omitted from diagnostics.','ridge':ridge,'noise_rows':len(noise),'key_gram_condition':float(np.linalg.cond(key_gram)),'reader_norms':np.linalg.norm(readers,axis=-1).tolist()}
with open('acts/construction_metadata.json','w') as stream:
 json.dump(report,stream,indent=2)
PY
